**Description**
*Position at Optimas International*
 Senior Full Stack Java Developer (8\+ Years Experience)
   

  

 Position: Senior Full Stack Java Developer
   

  

 Location: Pune, Maharashtra (Hybrid)
   

  

 Company: Optimas International
   

  

 Experience: 8–12\+ Years
   

  

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

  

**About Optimas**
 Optimas is a global industrial distributor and supply chain solutions provider specializing in fasteners, components, inventory management, and engineering services. Operating across North America, Europe, and Asia, Optimas enables manufacturers to optimize supply chains through technology\-driven solutions.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Full Stack Java Developer who can contribute across backend, frontend, database, DevOps, and production support functions while helping drive modernization initiatives across enterprise applications.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

* The Senior Full Stack Java Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, enhancing, and supporting enterprise\-grade web applications used across global business operations.
* The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Java/Spring Boot backend development, Oracle database programming, modern frontend technologies (Angular/React), REST API integration, Docker, GitLab CI/CD, and secure software development practices.
* The role requires hands\-on technical leadership, mentoring capabilities, and the ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams across multiple regions.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Full Stack Application Development
   

  

* Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise web applications.
* Build scalable backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
* Develop responsive, user\-friendly, and accessible web interfaces using Angular and/or React.
* Implement reusable frontend components and shared UI libraries.
* Integrate frontend applications with RESTful backend services.
* Collaborate with business analysts, product owners, architects, and Business/QA teams to deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Participate in technical design discussions and architecture reviews.


 Backend Development
   

  

* Design and develop REST APIs and microservices using:
+ Java 8/11/17\+
+ Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate
+ Jasper Reports
+ ZPL II

* Implement business logic with a focus on scalability and maintainability.
* Build secure APIs following enterprise security standards.
* Write unit and integration tests.


 Frontend Development
   

  

* Develop modern web applications using:
+ Angular, React.js, TypeScript
+ JavaScript (ES6\+)
+ HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, Material UI / Angular Material

* Implement responsive designs compatible across browsers and devices.
* Develop dashboards, forms, data grids, and reporting interfaces.
* Handle state management and API integration.
* Optimize frontend performance and user experience.
* Ensure secure client\-side development practices.


 API Integration \& Connectivity
   

  

* Develop seamless connectivity between frontend, backend, and database layers.
* Consume and expose RESTful APIs.
* Design request/response contracts and API documentation.
* Handle authentication, authorization, and secure data exchange.
* Troubleshoot integration issues across application layers.
* Work with JSON, XML, and third\-party integrations.


 DevOps \& CI/CD
   

  

* Contribute to GitLab\-based CI/CD implementation.
* Create Docker images and support containerized deployments.
* Manage environment\-specific configurations.
* Support release and deployment activities.


 Containerization \& Deployment
   

  

* Develop and maintain Dockerized applications.
* Create multi\-stage Docker builds.
* Support deployments in on\-premises environments.
* Configure application health checks and monitoring.
* Manage certificates, secrets, and environment variables securely.
* Collaborate with infrastructure teams for deployment readiness.


 Security \& Compliance
   

  

* Perform code reviews focusing on security and performance.
* Address vulnerabilities identified through scanning tools.
* Protect applications against:
+ SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, SSRF
+ Authentication and Authorization flaws

* Ensure proper handling of secrets and sensitive information.


 Production Support \& Operations Skills
   

  

* Participate in production deployments and release activities.
* Provide application support and maintenance, ensuring timely identification and resolution of issues.
* Troubleshoot issues across applications, databases, and system integrations.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive measures to avoid issues.


 Database Technologies
   

  

* SQL Server
* SQL Query Optimization
* Database Performance Tuning


 DevOps \& Tools
   

  

* GitLab CI/CD
* Docker
* Linux/Unix
* SonarQube
* Nexus/Artifactory


 Security
   

  

* Secure Coding Practices
* OAuth2, JWT
* TLS/SSL
* Vulnerability Management


**Experience Requirements**
 Candidates should demonstrate:
   

  

* 8\+ years of software development experience.
* 5\+ years of Java/Spring Boot development.
* 3\+ years of Angular and/or React development.
* Experience building full\-stack enterprise applications.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerization.
* Experience supporting production systems in enterprise environments.


 Education: Bachelor’s or master’s Degree in:
   

  

* Computer Science
* Information Technology
* Software Engineering
* Related Engineering Discipline

 We are looking for an experienced R\&D Engineer to join the team responsible for building and optimizing the high\-performance packet capture pipeline at the core of our network analytics platform. The platform operates as a containerized DPDK application on bare\-metal Kubernetes worker nodes and delivers wire\-speed packet acquisition from physical network interfaces. This role offers the opportunity to work across the complete technology stack, from Linux kernel\-level provisioning and NIC driver management to DPDK\-based packet processing, modern C\+\+ development, and Kubernetes\-based deployment automation.

* **Experience: 5 to 8 Years**

* Design, develop, and optimize high\-performance DPDK\-based packet capture applications.
* Implement and enhance RX thread architecture, memory pool management, Receive Side Scaling (RSS), and packet timestamping capabilities.
* Develop and maintain hardware abstraction layers supporting multiple packet capture backends, including DPDK, PCIe capture cards, pcap/live capture, and ZMQ injection.
* Build and enhance Python\-based node provisioning utilities and Ansible automation playbooks.
* Configure worker nodes for DPDK workloads, including hugepages, CPU isolation, IOMMU settings, NIC driver binding, and node labeling.
* Own and maintain Kubernetes Helm charts supporting DPDK infrastructure deployment.
* Enable efficient node\-label\-driven PCI device allocation and resource provisioning.

* Develop automated and manual testing frameworks for packet capture pipelines and infrastructure components.

* Participate in architecture reviews, technical discussions, and code reviews.
* Create and maintain technical documentation and operational procedures.

* 5\+ years of experience in software development with strong expertise in C\+\+.

* Experience developing latency\-sensitive and high\-throughput multi\-threaded applications.

 As an Analyst Global Fleet Management, you will play a key role in enabling data\-driven fleet management across Siemens Energy’s global vehicle fleet. * Collaborate with regional and global stakeholders to improve data quality, reporting transparency, and decision\-making processes.
* Drive automation and standardization of reporting processes while preparing management\-ready analyses and presentations.


**What You Bring**
* University degree in Business Administration, Data Analytics, Supply Chain Management, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field with 3\+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience in data analytics, reporting, business intelligence, procurement, fleet management, or a similar analytical role within an international environment.
* Strong expertise in data management, KPI development, reporting, and dashboard creation using tools such as Power BI, Excel, SAP, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of fleet management principles, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), vehicle lifecycle management, sustainability metrics, and compliance requirements is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills with a structured and detail\-oriented approach.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate complex data into business insights.
* Fluency in English; additional language capabilities are a plus.


**About The Team**
 You will be part of Siemens Energy’s Business Functions organization, supporting global operations through best\-in\-class services and solutions across IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy \& Technology, and other key business areas.
   

  

 The team fosters collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement, helping business stakeholders make informed decisions through data\-driven insights and operational excellence.

 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Job Description: Technical SAP Signavio Architect/Tecno\-Functional Consultant

 We are seeking a highly skilled SAP Signavio Tecno\-Functional Consultant with
 



 extensive hands\-on technical capabilities to lead end\-to\-end business process
 



 transformation, optimization, and process mining initiatives. Unlike traditional functional
 



 roles, this position demands a deep understanding of data architectures, systems
 



 integration, and hands\-on technical development.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business operations and technical data
 



 engineering, actively building data pipelines, profiling source data, setting up complex
 



 system integrations via SAP BTP, and writing advanced queries to power operational
 



 dashboards and process intelligence metrics.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Module\-Specific Functional Management
 



  SAP Signavio Process Manager: Establish and enforce workspace modeling
 



 conventions, govern the central corporate Dictionary for reusable business
 



 terms/objects, and model end\-to\-end process hierarchies using BPMN 2\.0 and
 



 DMN (Decision Model and Notation). Conduct process simulations and perform
 



 structured \"As\-Is\" vs. \"To\-Be\" diagram comparisons to evaluate impact.
 



  





  SAP Signavio Process Insights: Configure rapid connections to core SAP
 



 ERP/S/4HANA instances to gain immediate, automated visibility into business
 



 processes. Analyze standard out\-of\-the\-box performance indicators (such as
 



 automation rates, backlogs, and throughput), interpret industry benchmarking
 



 data, and execute standard correction or innovation recommendations.
 



  





  SAP Signavio Process Intelligence: Lead advanced process mining discovery
 



 initiatives across multi\-system environments. Execute detailed conformance
 



 checks to analyze actual execution against standard target models, and identify
 



 process execution leakage including compliance violations, unwanted loops, and
 



 manual workarounds.
 



  





 2\. Process Mining \& Data Profiling (Technical Hands\-on)
 



  Perform exhaustive data profiling and structural data analysis across SAP and
 



 non\-SAP source environments to validate data quality and completeness before
 



 process ingestion.
 



  





  Design, build, and maintain data ingestion pipelines for SAP Signavio Process
 



 Intelligence, mapping transactional data to event logs (Case ID, Activity,
 



 Timestamp).
 



  





  Identify data anomalies, concurrency issues, and gaps in transactional logs,
 



 implementing robust transformations to resolve them.
 



  





 3\. Integration \& SAP BTP Engineering
 



  Configure, establish, and optimize secure data connections between SAP
 



 Signavio and various backend applications (including third\-party ERPs, CRMs,
 



 legacy databases, and cloud services).

 data orchestration, data federation, and custom extension developments.
 



  





  Implement API\-based integrations and utilize JDBC/ODBC connectors, secure
 



 file transfers, and cloud ingestion agents to capture real\-time or batch
 



 transactional records.
 



  





 4\. Query Development \& Analytics
 



  Write, debug, and optimize complex queries using SIGNAL (Signavio Process
 



 Mining Query Language) and standard SQL to extract process insights and
 



 calculate critical KPIs.
 



  





  Develop advanced process dashboards, custom metrics, and automated alerts
 



 within SAP Signavio Process Intelligence to expose process bottlenecks,
 



 variations, and compliance violations.
 



  





  Build predictive metrics and custom logic to track process behavior and trigger
 



 operational actions based on data patterns.
 



  





 5\. Process Modeling \& Functional Analysis
 



  Lead collaborative process discovery workshops with business stakeholders to
 



 model \"As\-Is\" and \"To\-Be\" business processes using BPMN 2\.0 standards within SAP Signavio Process Manager.
 



  





  Translate analytical findings from process mining into actionable business
 



 optimization strategies, collaborating with functional process owners.
 



  





  Align custom developments with standard SAP Best Practices and Signavio
 



 Value Accelerators to accelerate digital transformation milestones (e.g., SAP
 



 S/4HANA migrations).
 



  





 Required Technical \& Functional Qualifications
 



  





  Experience: Minimum of 5 to 10 years of professional experience in Business
 



 Process Management (BPM) and Process Mining, with at least 5 years of direct,
 



 hands\-on technical implementation experience using the SAP Signavio Suite.
 



  





  Functional Competencies:
 



 o Extensive knowledge of Process Manager, including business
 



 architecture design, simulation setups, and DMN decision tables.
 



 o Deep proficiency in Process Insights, including setting up automated
 



 data extractions, analyzing standard process flows, tracking master data
 



 categories, and navigating the Variant Explorer.
 



 o Masterful command of Process Intelligence functional configurations,
 



 identifying root causes, managing metrics, and aligning data\-driven
 



 findings with stakeholders.
 



  





  Signavio Toolset Mastery: Proven expertise across SAP Signavio Process
 



 Intelligence (specifically the ETL layer), Process Manager, and Collaboration
 



 Hub.
 



  





  Database \& Query Skills: Exceptional proficiency in writing complex queries in
 



 standard SQL and SIGNAL. Deep understanding of relational database
 



 management systems (RDBMS), data warehousing concepts, and schema
 



 design.
 



  





  SAP BTP \& Middleware: Practical, hands\-on experience using SAP BTP for
 



 data integration, orchestration, or application deployment. Familiarity with SAP
 



 Integration Suite (Cloud Integration) is highly advantageous.
 



  





  Third\-Party Integrations: Demonstrated track record connecting Signavio to
 



 non\-SAP systems (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle, or custom legacy
 



 databases) via REST/SOAP APIs and standard database connectors.
 



  





  Data Engineering: Experience in ETL/ELT development, data profiling tools,
 



 data cleansing methodology, and transforming raw transactional tables into event
 



 logs.
 



  





 Preferred Professional Qualifications

 Cash (O2C), Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), or Record\-to\-Report (R2R).

 stakeholders.
